myTeam.yourTeamsSub: Jump into any of your teams.
myTeam.title: My team
myTeam.emptySub: You're not on a team yet — join one near you, accept an invite, or start your own.
myTeam.findSub: Discover teams near you — many lend gear and welcome newcomers.

create.title: Create a team
create.subtitle: You'll be the team's first admin.
create.name: Team name
create.slugHint: Your permanent link — lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens. Can't be changed later.
create.cityHint: City teams show up when players search their area.
create.mixteamNote: No city needed. A Mixteam is players from different cities who enter tournaments together.

settings.title: Team settings
settings.notFound: This team doesn't exist, or you're not a member.
settings.beginnersWelcomeHint: Show a “Beginners” badge and appear in the beginners filter.
settings.soleAdminWarning: You're the only admin. Make someone else an admin before you step down or leave.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}} for everyone? This removes the team, its news and roster. It can't be undone.
settings.deleteHint: Admins only · removes the team, its news and roster for everyone. Can't be undone.
settings.adminsOnly: Only admins can change team settings.

inviteAccept.invalidBody: Ask a team admin to send you a fresh one.
inviteAccept.expiredBody: Invite links last 7 days. Ask a team admin to send you a fresh one.
inviteAccept.invitedBy: {{name}} invited you to join. New members join as players.

invitations.title: Invite people
invitations.anyoneCanJoin: anyone with it can accept and join as a player.
invitations.revokeHint: Revoke cancels an invite before it's accepted.

detail.notFoundBody: No team exists at that address.
detail.partyFull: Full right now — reopens automatically if a spot frees.
detail.declinedNote: You declined — you can still hop in while there's room.
detail.newsPlaceholder: Share an update with your team…
detail.trainingsDesc: Recurring sessions your team can respond to.

detail.notFoundBody: This event doesn't exist or the link is wrong.
detail.cancelled: Cancelled by the organiser. No new sign-ups are being accepted.
detail.bankTransferNote: Bank transfer only — no in-app payment. An admin confirms your payment to admit you.

join.fullWaitlistNote: This event is full. You can still join the waiting list — an admin promotes people manually as spots open. You're not charged unless a spot opens.
join.entered: Entered — your team is on the event
join.beingFilled: Being filled — not on the event yet
join.enterPartyHint: Teams enter as a party — pull a crew together for this event.
join.adminsCanEnter: Your team's admins can enter a party for this event.
join.statusAwaiting: Awaiting approval — pay to confirm your spot
join.statusWaitlisted: On the waiting list — you're not charged unless a spot opens

inviteAccept.invitedBy: {{name}} invited you to help administer this event.
inviteAccept.expired: This invite has expired — ask an organiser for a fresh one.
inviteAccept.invalid: This invite is no longer valid.

manage.notAllowedBody: Only an event admin can manage this event.
manage.title: Manage participants

edit.notAllowedBody: Only an event admin can edit this event.
edit.title: Event settings
edit.subtitle: Edit the details or cancel the event.
edit.name: Name
edit.limitHint: Can't drop below the {{count}} already taking part. Teams-vs-individuals can't change after sign-ups.
edit.cancelWarning: Cancelling can't be undone. The page stays up marked cancelled, no new sign-ups are accepted, and everyone joined or waiting is notified.

admins.notAllowedBody: Only an event admin can manage co-admins.
admins.title: Co-admins
admins.subtitle: Co-admins can edit, post news, and manage participants.

contactsManage.notAllowedBody: Only an event admin can manage contacts.
contactsManage.subtitle: Who participants can reach. Shown on the event page.
contactsManage.hint: Add a phone, an email, or both.

account.title: Account
account.subtitle: Protected sample page — you only see this when signed in.

notifications.title: Notification settings
notifications.subtitle: Choose how you hear about things. Changes save automatically — there's no save button.
notifications.saveError: We couldn't save that change. Check your connection and try the toggle again.
notifications.loadErrorBody: Something went wrong on our end. Give it another go.
notifications.alwaysOnDesc: These keep your account safe, so they can't be turned off.

browse.empty: Nothing here yet — check back soon.
browse.noResults: No matches for your search and filters.

players.note: Every player on JuggerHub is listed here.

home.errorBody: Something went wrong reaching the server.

home.needsYouMany: You've got {{count}} things waiting on you.
home.nothingCalendar: Nothing on your calendar yet — go find a game.
home.notOnTeamTitle: You're not on a team yet
home.notOnTeamBody: Discover teams near you — many lend gear and welcome newcomers. No pressure; come try a training first.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Welcome back to JuggerHub.
signIn.verifyNotice: Please verify your email address before signing in.
signIn.resent: If that account needs it, a new verification email is on its way.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Join JuggerHub with your email and a password.
register.checkEmailBody: If that email can be registered, we've sent a link to verify your address. Open it to activate your account, then sign in.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for that address, we've sent a link to reset your password. The link expires shortly, so use it soon.

reset.doneBody: Your password has been updated and other sessions were signed out. You can now sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidBody: This reset link is missing information. Request a new one to continue.
reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a strong password you don't use elsewhere.

verify.verifyingBody: One moment while we confirm your address.
verify.successBody: Your account is active. You can now sign in.
verify.failedBody: This verification link is invalid or has expired. Enter your email to get a new one.
verify.resent: If that account needs verifying, a new link is on its way.

welcome.title: Welcome to Jugger
welcome.subtitle: Let's set up your player profile — takes about a minute.

name.title: What should we call you?
name.subtitle: Your display name — change it anytime.

city.title: Where are you based?
city.subtitle: Pick your home city — it powers teams and events near you.

team.title: Find your team
team.introNear: Teams closest to you first — the ones looking for new players are marked "Beginners". Or search by name for any team.
team.introFar: These teams are looking for new players — or search by name to find any other team.
team.loadError: We couldn't load teams just now.
team.noResults: No teams match that — try a different name.
team.emptyLooking: No teams are looking for new players right now — search by name to find any team.
team.askedConfirmation: We've asked {{name}} to let you in — an admin still has to say yes.
team.notOnTeam: I'm not on a team yet
